issues.title: Missing Mermaid Source Files
issues.why: The spec references 'lifecycle-10-research-lifecycle.mmd' and '01-research-index/lifecycle-top-research.mmd' as normative sources, but these files are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include the raw .mmd files in the module file list or inline the Mermaid code directly into the overview files.

issues.title: Undefined Linter Script Logic
issues.why: Multiple ACs (AC-05, AC-07, AC-RESEARCH-07) rely on specific python/node scripts (check-tree-health.cjs, check-spec-cross-links.py) whose logic for 'strict gates' is not defined.
issues.fix: Provide the core logic or pseudo-code for the linter scripts in a 'Tooling' section.

issues.title: Registry Table Type Mismatch
issues.why: The SQL DDL uses 'TEXT' for AuthoredAt, while the Validation Schema expects 'date-time' format; SQLite does not enforce ISO-8601 by default.
issues.fix: Add a CHECK constraint to the SQL DDL: CHECK(AuthoredAt IS datetime(AuthoredAt)).
